messages:
Anita P: Quick sync — consolidating postmortem follow-ups from last week's outage. I want a concise action list we can track and close before the next game day.
Marco L: Yep, share the list and owners please. @Sophie FYI.
Anita P: Draft actions: 1) BGP/multi-region failover dry-run coverage (owner: Marco, due 2026-04-06) 2) Restore runbook with step-by-step checklist + rollback gates (owner: Sophie, due 2026-04-02) 3) Backup retention & snapshot audit (owner: Devon, due 2026-04-09) 4) Automate pre-game health checks and alerts (owner: Platform Eng, due 2026-04-15) 5) Monthly snapshot-restore rehearsal in non-prod (owners: Marco/Devon, recurring monthly)
Sophie J: I'll take the restore runbook. Plan: add a "quick verify" checklist, explicit approval gate, and a short play script for roles. ETA 2026-04-02. Will link doc here: http://intranet/docs/dr/runbook (draft).
Devon R: Backup audit ack. Quick note: two S3 buckets have different lifecycle rules; I'll generate a CSV of snapshots missing expected retention and propose policy updates. ETA 2026-04-09.
Marco L: For BGP/failover tests I propose a dry-run Wednesday 03:00 UTC. Need a traffic cutover plan and comms checklist. Can infra-bot schedule the run?
infra-bot: scheduledplaybook: "DR dry-run - BGP failover" scheduled for 2026-03-31 03:00 UTC. Participants: Marco L, Anita P, Sophie J, Devon R.
Sophie J: I'll add a failback verification section — explicit post-failover checks (DNS propagation, route table asserts, health-check sweep).
Anita P: Owners recap: Marco = BGP tests + failover orchestration, Sophie = runbook + checklist + game-day script, Devon = backup audit + monthly restores, Platform Eng = automation hooks & alerts. Add risk ratings and clear rollback knobs.
Marco L: Quick question: keep warm-standby promotion manual or automatic? I lean manual for now — add an approval gate in the runbook.
Devon R: Agree manual promotion. Also proposing monthly snapshot restore job in non-prod to validate both snapshot integrity and restore scripts.
Sophie J: I'll include a game-day play script with role assignments (signaler, switcher, monitor). Minimal operator commands included (examples below).
Sophie J: ```bash
# BGP withdraw example (mock)
# run on control host
bgpctl withdraw-route --prefix 10.2.0.0/16
# verify route table: curl -s http://internal-metrics/route-check | jq .status
```
Anita P: I'll open a JIRA epic and link the postmortem. Any objections to the above due dates?
Marco L: Fine by me. Also let's add a metric: "time to restore from snapshot" target <= 45m as an SLI and track it during rehearsals.
Devon R: Noted. I'll include estimated restore times in the audit CSV and flag long restores.
infra-bot: jira: created epic RI-2345 "DR - postmortem followups". Created tickets: RI-2346 (BGP dry-run), RI-2347 (runbook + checklist), RI-2348 (backup retention audit).
Sophie J: One recurring pattern I spotted in the postmortem: KV-cache warm-up causing high latency after failover. I'll add a cache-priming step and a short traffic-replay to pre-seed caches.
Marco L: Good catch. Add a pre-seed traffic replay step to the playbook (script at /repo/ops/dr/replay). We'll run it as part of the dry-run pre-checks.
Anita P: Final checklist for closure: schedule dry-run, update runbook with approval gates & cache priming, finish backup audit, set up monthly restore job, add SLI for restore time, and attach retro notes to JIRA. Reconvene 2026-04-07 for a closure sync. :calendar: 
Devon R: ACK — I'll post the CSV and policy diffs when audit completes.
Sophie J: ACK.
Marco L: ACK.
Anita P: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
